description: We are ninth-grade students from Guatemala passionate about science, technology, and innovation. We aim to gain experience, improve our problem-solving and teamwork skills, and prepare for future competitions. We are eager to learn, collaborate, and contribute with creativity and determination.
summary: Mars Outpost Commander is an interactive educational simulation in which the player takes on the role of commander of a base on Mars. The player must keep vital systems operational during a compressed “Martian day” and submit a report to Earth. Every decision involves a trade-off: improving one system comes at the expense of another. The game incorporates real facts from NASA to teach—in an engaging, playful way—about the challenges of habitability on Mars. It is an accessible, fast-paced tool based on open data that raises awareness about human exploration of the planet Mars.
details:
The player manages a Martian base in compressed real-time. They must keep five key indicators above 40% by controlling:

Solar panels and energy infrastructure

Crop production

Radiation armor

Communications

Exploration rovers

Repairs (leaks, dust storm damage, etc.)

Every action has immediate and often conflicting consequences. A report is generated at the end of each day. Contextual “NASA Facts” are also displayed.
